get.description: Starts the OIDC sign-in (302 to the identity provider). Repeated starts from one client network return 429 request_limit with Retry-After (a browser navigation receives a page that returns to /app?auth=request_limit).

post.description: Online directory command. Requires server-provisioned scope, antiforgery and a 16–80 character Idempotency-Key. Updates require expectedVersion; stale changes return 409. Replay returns the fresh authorized representation.

get.description: Critical-state explanations for one vessel: owning source and revision, reason codes, server-computed freshness and blockers with resolution types. Never a ready, verified or compliant outcome. Readers without the owning detail authority receive STATE_ONLY entries without source details; components without a state capability are omitted.

get.summary: 55.01 metric registry entries the actor may view. Definition only; no formula designer or export.
Evaluates one registered scalar over records the actor can currently read. SUPPRESSED, UNKNOWN and UNAVAILABLE carry no value; zero is never substituted for a missing source.
Caller's current membership state and currently effective received delegations. Delegations are context for exact action checks, not generic grants.
Tenant memberships (persisted lifecycle state). Issuer/subject are never returned.

post.description: Invites an IdP identity to a database membership (USER-ADMIN-02). The membership starts Invited and grants nothing; it binds an identity only when the identity holder, signed in through the trusted issuer, accepts the single-use invitation token returned once in this response (expiry: the tenant's 54.01 account.invite_hours value, 1-168 hours, default 24). deliveryEmail is optional and queues the invitation e-mail in the same transaction (delivery state QUEUED, or NOT_CONFIGURED without a mail transport); the address is never returned, logged or audited. Invitation create and reissue share a technical limit per administrator (60 per 15 minutes); beyond it 429 request_limit with Retry-After. subject is optional and, when given, is the only identity allowed to accept; it reserves nothing. Role bundles and individual permissions are limited to the trusted allow-list and to the caller's own permissions (400 exceeds_grantor_authority). A subject present in the operator configuration, already bound in this tenant or with a pending invitation here returns 409 identity_unavailable.

get.summary: Delegations where the membership is source or delegate. State is computed from server time.

post.description: Approves a time-boxed delegation from this membership with a mandatory closed reasonCode and an explicit company/vessel scope. The approver can be neither source nor delegate; permissions and scope cannot exceed the source's current grant (400 exceeds_source_scope); tenant-wide scope is never delegated; re-delegation is not possible.

Deterministically imports operator-provisioned memberships of the caller's tenant that have no persisted record. Never changes existing records and never widens access. Entries that cannot be imported (including an identity already bound in another tenant) are skipped with a closed reason; configuration keeps governing them. Replay returns the original result.

Requires antiforgery, a 16–80 character Idempotency-Key and server-provisioned membership.manage with tenant-wide manage scope and a trusted role. Transitions require expectedVersion; stale changes return 409. Voluntary removal of the last active identity administrator returns 409 last_admin. Replay returns the fresh representation.

Requires antiforgery, a 16–80 character Idempotency-Key and server-provisioned membership.manage with tenant-wide manage scope and a trusted role. Transitions require expectedVersion; stale changes return 409. Voluntary removal of the last active identity administrator returns 409 last_admin. Replay returns the fresh representation. Resuming a security suspension requires membership.security.suspend (membership.manage alone returns 403) and closes its RECOVERY_REQUIRED case.

Requires antiforgery, a 16–80 character Idempotency-Key and server-provisioned membership.manage with tenant-wide manage scope and a trusted role. Transitions require expectedVersion; stale changes return 409. Voluntary removal of the last active identity administrator returns 409 last_admin. Replay returns the fresh representation.
Forced security suspension (membership.security.suspend). Not blocked by the last-admin guard; removing the last administrator records RECOVERY_REQUIRED and creates no hidden administrator.

Requires antiforgery, a 16–80 character Idempotency-Key and server-provisioned membership.manage with tenant-wide manage scope and a trusted role. Transitions require expectedVersion; stale changes return 409. Voluntary removal of the last active identity administrator returns 409 last_admin. Replay returns the fresh representation.

get.summary: Role bundles, the trusted permission allow-list grouped by module, tenant vessels/companies and what the caller may grant. Requires membership.read or membership.manage with tenant-wide scope.
Tenant memberships with their grant source, bundles and scope. Filters: status, bundle, q (membership/account id prefix or exact IdP subject; subjects are never returned).
Effective grant, scope and immutable grant revision history of one membership.

post.description: Appends a new immutable grant revision to an admin-provisioned membership. expectedVersion is the current grant revision (stale ⇒ 409 version_conflict). Own membership ⇒ 403 self_modification; configuration-managed ⇒ 409 configuration_managed; removing the last active administrator ⇒ 409 last_admin. Takes effect on the member's next request.

Issues a new single-use invitation link for an Invited membership (the previous pending link stops working). The token is returned only in this response. expectedVersion is the membership version; a membership that is no longer Invited returns 409 invalid_transition. Shares the invitation create limit per administrator (60 per 15 minutes): 429 request_limit with Retry-After.

get.summary: The tenant's invitation lifetime (54.01 account.invite_hours, 1-168 h, default 24) and whether invitation e-mail delivery is configured. Requires membership.read or membership.manage with tenant-wide scope.

post.description: Sets the tenant's invitation lifetime in hours (54.01 account.invite_hours: 1-168). Applies to invitations issued afterwards; existing invitations keep their expiry. expectedVersion is the settings version (0 while the source default applies); stale => 409 version_conflict; out of range => 400 validation_failed.

Shows the signed-in identity what a pending invitation grants in its tenant. No change is made. Every refusal (unknown, expired, used, revoked, another identity, identity already bound or configured) returns the same 409 invitation_unavailable; repeated attempts return 429 request_limit.

Binds the signed-in IdP identity (validated issuer+subject) to the invited membership and activates its grant. One identity holds at most one accepted membership. The invitation session ends; the grant applies at the next sign-in. Every refusal returns the same 409 invitation_unavailable; repeated attempts return 429 request_limit.

get.summary: Process liveness only; does not indicate database or operational readiness.
Public technical connectivity check. No business data or safety approval.

put.description: Draft only. Trusted vessel edit grant, CSRF and Idempotency-Key required. expectedVersion 0 creates an absent draft; otherwise use returned xmin. No submission, verification or operational release.

get.description: Per-field value version, declared provenance and computed freshness. Declared sources are never verification; without an approved freshness policy every field is UNKNOWN with a reason.

post.description: Appends one declared (unverified) source for the exact current field value version. Trusted vessel edit grant, CSRF and Idempotency-Key required; expectedValueRevision and expectedSequence are compare-and-set fences.

get.summary: Pilot telemetry schema and whether this membership is enrolled. No identity or stored value is returned.

post.summary: Records one closed-code pilot event batch for the trusted actor. Free text, identities and record ids are not accepted.

get.summary: Pilot metric observations over a bounded window. SUPPRESSED, UNKNOWN and UNAVAILABLE carry no value; zero is never substituted.

get.description: config.read. Registered 54.01 CFG3 definition subset with source locators; the source declares 354 definitions. Registration is not owner adapter admission.

config.resolve. Query key, scopeKind TENANT|COMPANY|VESSEL, scopeId (COMPANY/VESSEL), applicability (base64url canonical JSON object), mode CURRENT|HISTORICAL, effectiveAt+knownAt (HISTORICAL only). Reports status RESOLVED|UNCONFIGURED|AMBIGUOUS|BLOCKED|UNKNOWN with source scope and version; never fabricates a value.
config.read. Immutable revision and decision lineage of one parameter root; version is the CAS token for decisions.

post.description: config.draft. Proposes one typed value revision (IN_REVIEW). expectedVersion 0 creates the root. Owner fields, invariants, aliases and family references are rejected with 422. No approval, schedule or activation.
config.approve. Independent approver only (maker != checker). The selection is append-only and effective no earlier than the decision.
config.reject. Independent reviewer only; REJECTED is terminal and never selectable.
